intel.title: [CISA KEV] MikroTik RouterOS - Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-67279
廠商: MikroTik
產品: RouterOS
漏洞名稱: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
說明: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-28
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2026-67279）存在於 MikroTik RouterOS 中，允許未經授權的攻擊者建立工作階段並執行指令。該漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV 且存在活躍攻擊，可與其他漏洞串聯以實現遠端程式碼執行（RCE）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft SharePoint - Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-65660
廠商: Microsoft
產品: SharePoint
漏洞名稱: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-28
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Microsoft SharePoint 存在代碼注入漏洞（CVE-2026-65660），允許已授權的攻擊者透過網路執行任意代碼。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知活躍利用（KEV）清單，具有極高安全風險。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] WordPress Core - WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-87902
廠商: WordPress
產品: Core
漏洞名稱: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
說明: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-28
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: WordPress Core 存在遠端檔案包含 (RFI) 漏洞 (CVE-2026-87902)，未經授權的攻擊者可藉此在 active theme 目錄外引入惡意 .php 檔案並執行任意程式碼 (RCE)。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入 KEV（已知遭利用漏洞清單），且公司內部正使用 WordPress 作為部落格平台，面臨直接且嚴重的入侵風險。
analysis.recommendation:
1. 立即將所有 WordPress 網站核心版本升級至官方釋出的最新安全修補版本（請參考官方安全公告 GHSA-7hp8-65ch-5whp）。
2. 在完成升級前，於 AWS WAF 或相關防護設備上啟用針對 RFI 與 RCE 攻擊的過濾規則，阻斷異常的頁面模板請求。
3. 檢查 WordPress 伺服器日誌，排查是否有異常的外部檔案讀取或未授權的 .php 檔案執行紀錄。
